name: DRCOG Building Roofprints 2024
license: DRCOG Regional Data Catalog: served open and unauthenticated; explicit terms not retrievable from the portal (JS front end over an authenticated API) as probed 2026-08-17
notes: Roofprints, not footprints, which is the distinction that matters here: a roofprint is the roof edge seen from above, and that is exactly the outline airborne returns actually describe. A ground footprint differs from it by the overhang, so matching returns to a footprint charges the compiler for a discrepancy the sensor could never have resolved. Carries Bldg_Height and Ground_Elevation, same schema family as the City's Building Outlines. CAUTION: 1,839 features over the AOI against the City's 1,821, with matching field names -- these are probably one stereocompilation lineage, in which case they do not corroborate each other and only one may be used to score.
